briefing_text: Deccan Freight Lines (V-1004) is a logistics vendor on Net 30 terms. It regularly bills a fuel surcharge of up to 5% above the PO, covered by a contract amendment. Priya Nair approved this twice (CASE-0001 at +4.0%, CASE-0003 at +4.5%). Anything above 5% has no precedent and goes to a human. Bank detail changes are always escalated.
